results.title: 1969 Porsche 912 Coupe
results.description: This 1969 Porsche 912 coupe was acquired by the seller in 2016 and was repainted in 2018. The car is finished in Medium Ivory over black leatherette upholstery and is powered by a 1.6-liter flat-four mated to a four-speed manual transaxle. Equipment includes 15" Fuchs forged alloy wheels, disc brakes, RS-style door panels, lap and shoulder belts, and a digital AM/FM radio. This 912 coupe is now offered with a car cover and a clean Kentucky title in the seller's name.
